source.split_rule: use recorded C1-02 split and root group unchanged

features.position_scaling: (p-C1-02_train_mean_m)/C1-02_train_std_m, population std ddof=0; reject nonpositive std
features.quaternion: C1-02 canonical unit wxyz, unchanged; reject noncanonical/nonfinite
features.q_current_scaling: (q_current-lower)/(upper-lower), frozen six joint limits; no wrapping or clamp

target.supervised_mask: label_present=true; missing wide rows remain in inventory and geometry evaluation
target.output_head: unbounded linear six-vector in normalized joint coordinates
target.loss: sum squared normalized joint error over 6, then mean over labeled rows; dimensionless
target.q_error_report: per-row mean absolute joint error in rad and per-row joint L2 in rad; report median/p95 by split and mode

training.seed_protocol: set Python random, NumPy and torch.manual_seed to training seed before model init; use separate NumPy PCG64(seed) permutation of fixed pair_id-sorted labeled train rows each epoch; same permutation for both models; deterministic torch algorithms; CPU single thread; no DataLoader workers
training.accumulation: if needed split each effective batch and backprop each micro-batch loss weighted by micro_count/effective_batch_count; optimizer step once per effective batch including final partial batch
training.epoch_coverage: all 15204 labeled train rows exactly once per epoch, including final partial effective batch; no drop_last
training.validation: after every epoch on all 3249 labeled validation rows in fixed pair_id order, no gradient; record loss by mode and overall
training.checkpoint_selection: strict lowest finite overall labeled validation mean loss; exact tie keeps earliest epoch; compare using full-precision float64 aggregated sum/count of float32 per-row loss
training.early_stop: paired seed lockstep: after each full epoch update each model's no-improvement counter; stop BOTH only when BOTH counters reach 20, or after epoch 200; same epoch and optimizer-step count per pair; no min_delta
training.nonfinite: abort run and retain evidence; never select NaN or Inf checkpoint

t_c03.subset: first 64 pair_id-lexical main/train/local labeled rows; fixed before outcomes
t_c03.monitor: first 32 pair_id-lexical main/validation/local labeled rows, disjoint root groups
t_c03.criterion: for each model: final train loss <= 0.5*epoch-0 train loss and final median absolute q error rad <= 0.75*epoch-0 median; all finite; validation tracked without pass threshold
t_c03.negative_control: cyclically shift labels across the 64 distinct train roots while preserving inputs/IDs; independent Pinocchio FK label-target Profile B validation must reject before training; altered feature order and missing-label/NaN cases must also fail fast

evaluation.reference_fk: independent PinocchioFK on physical q and target pose, base_link to tool0; check against F0-02 IndependentFK spot cases
evaluation.position_error: L2 target TCP position difference, metres
evaluation.raw_output_policy: count nonfinite and out-of-limit separately; reject invalid raw q for physical FK; never silently clip
evaluation.inventory: validation all 3600 rows including 351 unlabeled wide; q label error only on 3249 labeled rows; geometry on every valid raw output
evaluation.sealed: no test or F0-05/C1-01 benchmark metric before C1-06 independent gate

resources.checkpoint: one best and one last per model/seed, local only; temp-then-replace atomic write
resources.logs: one JSONL epoch record and one JSON run summary per model/seed; no per-row train log
resources.large_artifact_policy: LOCAL_ONLY; record path, byte count, SHA-256 and accessibility; remote archive NOT_CONFIRMED
